notes.title: Happy Holidays + Patch 1.03 is live!

Below is a list of the improvements and fixes we've prepared for this update.

[h1]1.03 PATCH NOTES[/h1][list][*] Adjusted the sensitivity slider once more to make sure the game plays great with mouse and controller as well
[*] Fixed a bug where the VSync setting was not memorized when exiting and reentering the game

[*] The F12 and print screen keys don't skip cut-scenes anymore, allowing you to take screenshots without skipping

notes.title: Secret Eden Log #6: "Technology & Advancements"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/213c49a294dd02b3a3141c890d64a6408ef5cc21.png[/img]

Hey guys! First and foremost, Everreach: Project Eden’s official release date is

[b]DECEMBER 4TH[/b]

So mark your calendars! ːsteamhappyː

And now, onto our third feature video, which is about the technology and special abilities available through the Elite Guardian Suit of Nora Harwood.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZAQhC5yJGA8
Nora’s Elite Guardian Suit can be upgraded in various ways. The suit’s offensive capabilities allow Nora to unlock skills such as the [b]Forcefield[/b] which acts as a makeshift cover during battle, blocking enemy attacks but allowing Nora’s shots to pass through. The forcefield can also be upgraded to withstand even stronger enemy fire and at its highest level, it can be deployed faster so Nora may truly shape the battlefield to her advantage.

[b]Shield Overload[/b] is another offensive ability of the Elite Guardian Suit that discharges all of Nora’s shields, destroying everything in her immediate vicinity. However, Nora needs to be careful about utilizing the overload ability, as it completely fries her personal shields, leaving her completely defenseless. For that reason, if Shield Overload is applied at the wrong time, Nora may quickly find herself surrounded by enemies and without the means to protect herself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/eef1d71faec9c8ea946464ca8587873e79cc40b6.jpg[/img]

[b]The Rush[/b] ability is a mix between an offensive and an agility-based ability. When activated, Rush allows the suit’s wearer to move and attack faster. For the duration of Rush, Nora can sprint endlessly without fatigue, allowing her to run for cover or surprise an enemy at the far side of the battlefield.

These are just a few ways Nora can upgrade her suit, its capabilities are numerous and the ways they can be combined together allow Nora to truly decide how she wishes to approach each conflict.

And that concludes our Secret Documentation series! In the name of EverReach Industries and our Security Division, we welcome you to Eden next week!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/915670

notes.title: Secret Eden Log #5: "Who is Who?"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/213c49a294dd02b3a3141c890d64a6408ef5cc21.png[/img]

Hey guys! We are heading straight for December - and with that to the release of Everreach: Project Eden! This is a very, very exciting time for me and the whole team here at Elder Games, and I can't wait to see you all playing the game that we worked on so hard over the last three years!

But now it's time to introduce you with the new "Secret Eden Log" to the "Who is Who" on planet Eden:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/7b5d775aefa8e97c3ed3cdff76b4b20afac8306f.png[/img]
Eager to support her family and secure them a better home, a young Nora Harwood enlisted as security for EverReach, a mega-corporation focused on designing luxury space colonies away from the crowded ruin of Earth. Now the youngest squad leader in the force, she receives an unusual mission; find out why Eden, the first colony on a livable planet, went off the grid. She arrives to find chaos: a strange mutiny, a mass slaughter, a colony under siege, and a mysteriously silent EverReach. Nora will need every ounce of her bravery, strength, and wits to survive and protect those she has come to save...



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/8746e4cecb3ae11de8c2c44765ec56e2e1aa766a.png[/img]
When Nora arrives on Eden, she’s soon split up from her squad and lacking backup; luckily, help is available in the form of the oddest little drone on the planet. A Compact Function Extra-terrestrial Assistant Robot – also known as a CFEAR - 73-Q offers a wide variety of technical tools and skills to get Nora out of (or into!) any number of scrapes. She also offers an even wider variety of terrible jokes and awkward moments thanks to her defective personality module.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/43ccf0a1c8b7dbe4e0e585f2cbf5ceafe966dd01.png[/img]
As Earth fell to pieces, Abigail turned her gaze to the stars, enlisting in EverReach’s security forces not only to see the galaxy, but to help the company find and build new homes out there. But when a strange mutiny threatens the colony of Eden, it will take all her strength to protect her new home and the people in it, and only Nora may be able to help her.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/efb6ed6ea114400ee5267cb52cac90796c8456e0.png[/img]
One of the top independent reporters at GlobalView News, Julian was invited to Eden to watch as the colony was constructed and report back on its wonders to an excited population back home on Earth. Instead, he got a front row seat to a harrowing bloodbath, and is now trapped with the remaining survivors. Still, he can’t shake the feeling that EverReach may be more responsible for the disaster than they let on...



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/d34a9c82628b3d492c0e5d48a379b9a6832a493c.png[/img]
Nora’s oldest and dearest friend from Earth, Jay joined EverReach Security at the same time as her. More cut out for mechanics than soldiering, he happily follows Nora’s lead on every mission… until they are separated during the task force’s arrival on Eden. Will he survive the nightmare without Nora’s help? And what will be left of him by the end of it?



https://store.steampowered.com/app/915670

notes.title: Secret Eden Log #4: "Safety And Care"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/213c49a294dd02b3a3141c890d64a6408ef5cc21.png[/img]

Hey guys! Our second feature video "Safety and Care" is about the duties of Nora Harwood’s security unit on Planet Eden. Like every modern mega-corp, EverReach employs its own personal security task force to handle company-related emergencies:

https://youtu.be/X-gKICG7TDw
Well-equipped and well-trained, its soldiers travel as needed between EverReach’s properties on Earth and their colony efforts on space stations and other worlds, serving as a mix of company muscle, tech support, and triage whenever there is a need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/c2fec7eea5be796b52ef14e574bb07fe6b7a005f.jpg[/img]
[i]The Zeus Hoverbike[/i]

EverReach Security consists of two informal “divisions”: standing security, who serve as permanently stationed security officers at EverReach colonies and installations, and task forces, small elite squads of 3-5 people who travel as assigned and deal with any crisis on EverReach property. Many of these are actually related to mechanical or technical issues: a factory explosion, a spaceship failure, a dropped communication, for instance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/af46b2fd443ec1951c67a7dd3b52b7651de4ef2b.jpg[/img]
[i]The Thermal Blaster[/i]

However, given multiple bad experiences involving rival company saboteurs and anti-corporate protesters, EverReach restructured so that every task force would include both technicians to solve mechanical issues and combat specialists to put down any hostile activity.

Nora Harwood is such a combat specialist. She’s well trained in weaponized combat, can handle various manned vehicles, such as the Zeus hoverbike and she’s also equipped with the latest generation Thermal Blaster and the XR-90 Rifle to handle extreme cases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/feb37f7719462f252ca4cb8c139d65701cb297d5.jpg[/img]
[i]The XR-90 Rifle[/i]

In the name of EverReach Industries and our Security Division, we welcome you to Eden!
EverReach, putting the stars in reach!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915670

notes.title: Secret Eden Log #3: "Creating an Extraterrestrial Planet"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/213c49a294dd02b3a3141c890d64a6408ef5cc21.png[/img]

Hey guys! Our third "Secret Eden Log" elaborates on the creation process of [b]Everreach: Project Eden[/b]. Creating the world of Eden has been a massive undertaking for an indie team like ours. It all started with a prototype version of the 3rd person controls where you could explore an empty grassland terrain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/8114d08c50ac2db8dab2a3c030d3eb37646dc2bf.jpg[/img]
[i]The very first screenshot from Everreach: Project Eden, 2016 September[/i]

Nora’s hair and clothing were just a placeholder at this point and other than walking around on an empty landscape you couldn’t do much. After that it was time to build our environmental assets and a brand new landscape to explore. And this is where the real challenge began.

Every single plant, every blade of grass had to be created from scratch. The goal was to design a custom armor for Nora and also fill the world with all kinds of plants, animals, waterfalls, cliffs and make it as much of a living, breathing environment as our budget allowed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/e3ae5acaeedc852da2a20e31e856f0308d644238.jpg[/img]
[i]Early concept art of Nora’s armor[/i]

In the next 5 months or so our team has designed over a dozen alien plants. We’ve also integrated numerous tools to help with level design, such as a tool to easily be able to „draw” rivers onto the landscape as well as be able to import our own custom trees into the game, which would then be affected by wind.

In February 2017 we already had a nice-looking environment and a functional 3rd person control system for Nora. Still, we had a long way to go. Nora’s controls had to be polished, and we needed to, you know, make the actual game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/d1288f0ff6fcce7e243745ae1c061b22a0381e2f.jpg[/img]
[i]Our first environment, February 2017[/i]

The majority of 2017 was spent implementing most features at a basic level. We had an early version of the game’s skill tree back then, we’ve built the foundation of the UI, we’ve added enemies that used the environment to their advantage to play against you, and the first few dialogue options were also available.

Arguably, one of the biggest features of the game is the skill tree containing over 80 upgrades. This is most likely the feature that went through the most changes throughout development. Luckily, we’ve built a tool early on where you could easily add or remove skills from this tree and our system would automatically handle skill prerequisites and rendering the skills along with how they are connected and which ones are available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/eef1d71faec9c8ea946464ca8587873e79cc40b6.jpg[/img]
[i]The game’s extensive skill tree with over 80 upgrades[/i]

In early 2018 we’ve reached a point where the Zeus hoverbike needed to be added to the game. The Zeus hoverbike is an important part of the game as it helps Nora traverse between certain locations.

Once the hoverbike was in, it became possible to start adding other biomes to the game. Throughout the remainder of development we’ve added forests, a swamp, grassy plains, other outposts and a massive desert area. During this time we kept polishing the controls and balancing the skills as best as we could, allowing multiple ways to upgrade Nora’s character.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/445b304e24d2a12c96d21199d2c49251c225b422.jpg[/img]

A month ago the game reached a near-finished state. We delayed the game’s release a bit further so we could polish the controls, add an aim-assist option, and put the finishing touches on a game that we’re very, very proud of.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915670

notes.title: Secret Eden Log #2: "Planet Eden"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/213c49a294dd02b3a3141c890d64a6408ef5cc21.png[/img]

Hey guys! Our second "Secret Eden Log" deals with planet Eden. It is one of the few habitable planets in our galaxy and the first EverReach Industries deemed worthy of colonization. It has a unique biosphere and diverse biomes like deserts, forests and caves, where you stumble upon hidden loot and optional story elements scattered throughout the environments.

EverReach Industries is the leader in planetary exploration and colonization building an exclusive luxury settlement in outer space for its wealthy customers. A team of scientists, mechanics, and construction workers are all working planetside, creating a network of settlements and cities for future colonists.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gGte3_hli30&feature=youtu.be
Unfortunately, due to unforeseen complications on-site, the official opening date has been slightly delayed. A team of highly trained specialists has been dispatched to Eden to evaluate the situation and restore regular operation as soon as possible.

This is where your story begins. Take on the role of Nora Harwood, Lieutenant of Everreach Industries' Security Division specialized in extraterrestrial operations, on a mission to secure the colonization process of Eden. Experience the intriguing story of Everreach: Project Eden, explore the vast alien world and discover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization. Throughout the story, there are several decisions for Nora to be made. People will remember and react to your choices, and these will also bring you to different endings of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/c2fec6bdda8d78015b183e4a9d64323b0bc9003b.jpg[/img]

[b]Everreach: Project Eden[/b] is a Third-Person Action RPG including a classical level system mixed with a variety of choices given by a skilltree with over 80 upgrades and special skills. Level up, spend attribute points and gain perks and bonuses through the skilltree. Choose your own playstyle, whether you want to deploy forcefields to take cover, speed up your attacks or overload your shields to do massive damage to all nearby enemies, it's all up to you.

Exploring a whole planet alone and on foot could prove a little overwhelming. The supporting unit drone 73-Q is at Nora's side whole the time, giving field support and assisting her. Besides that, you’re also equipped with a hoverbike and the Everreach security standard issue XR-09 Rifle as well as a Thermal Blaster. Strengthen and modify your weapons with perks from the skilltree to increase the ammo capacity, upgrade your weapons to deal armor piercing damage or activate special abilities and use your skills and to outsmart your opponents.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915670

notes.title: Secret Eden Log #1: "The Team behind Everreach"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/213c49a294dd02b3a3141c890d64a6408ef5cc21.png[/img]

Hey guys, I’m Ede Tarsoly [[url=https://twitter.com/EdeTarsoly]Twitter[/url]], lead designer and founder of [b]Elder Games[/b]. Before the development of [b]Everreach: Project Eden[/b] began, Elder Games had mostly been a one-man army with the occasional help from freelancers. I have slowly been working towards my goal of developing third-person action games, but I quickly realized that this is not something I can hope to accomplish alone. So, in 2016, I began recruiting a team.

[b]Gábor Menyhárt[/b]
Gábor has helped out numerous times with my projects in the past, and with his 16 years of experience (and counting) in 3D modeling, texturing and even 2D art, it made perfect sense to hire him as the lead GFX artist. It was his job to make sure the visual world of Everreach: Project Eden is coherent and built with care. He also produced numerous visual assets of the game himself, including the main protagonist’s armor and the UI.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4jmRxoVpXEA
[b]Michelle Clough[/b] [[url=https://twitter.com/michelle_clough]Twitter[/url]]
I also approached Michelle Clough, game writer and former narrative QA for the Mass Effect trilogy. The story concept of Everreach: Project Eden was mine, but Michelle wrote the entire script herself. She gave it a real heart and soul and truly brought the characters to life.

[b]Ferenc Szücs[/b]
Next to join the team was Ferenc, a world-class animator and level designer with over 14 years of experience. He helped us out with many of the main protagonist’s animations as well as some of the level design in the game.

[b]Rich Douglas[/b] [[url=https://twitter.com/rdouglasmusic]Twitter[/url]]
A composer known for Lifeless Planet and the Evochron series, Rich has written roughly one-third of the game’s soundtrack, helping me out in the early stages of the game, when I had to focus on setting up the game’s core systems. Rich’s music has also defined the tone and style of the entire soundtrack, as I’ve tried my best to keep his fantastic blend of 80’s synth and cinematic symphonic style in the rest of the songs.

So there you have it, we are the five core members of Elder Games. Programming, the rest of the music, most of the level design and directing are all my responsibilites, and I’ve also hired numerous freelancers for various tasks related to the game, including [b]Mai-Anh Tran[/b], who worked on the visuals of the WarCraft and Star Trek movies, as well as [b]D.C. Douglas[/b], voice actor for Wesker in Resident Evil and Legion in Mass Effect 2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35409549/370626eea161701729f33c5a7ceab1dfe792c55d.jpg[/img]
[i]Me composing music for Everreach: Project Eden[/i]

We’ve got a fantastic team and working together has been absolutely phenomenal. I cannot describe how amazing it has been to see a game like this slowly come to life. And now, we’re hoping to release it soon and show you all what we’ve been up to these past 3 years.

Within the next weeks till release we will publish various updates, that dive deeper into different elements and aspects of [b]Everreach: Project Eden[/b] - so stay tuned!

Cheers!
Ede

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915670

notes.title: "I am excited to play Everreach when it comes out this fall!"
notes.notes:
We recently showcased [b]Everreach: Project Eden[/b] at our booth at PAX West in Seattle with a fresh playable demo, showing the first 30 minutes of the game. Also the guys from [b]Rectifiy Gaming[/b] and [b]Stack Up[/b] came by to get their hands on the futuristic weaponary of the sci-fi action RPG!

And [url=https://stackup.org/pax-west-headup-games-publishing-launches-ambitious-sci-fi-rpg-everreach-project-eden-september-2019/][b]Stack Up[/b][/url] liked what they saw: [i]"Everreach: Project Eden strikes me as a similar game [related to the film "Oblivion" with Tom Cruise], in which we have a skilled female soldier, Nora Harwood, facing a strange enemy and uncovering a vast story. I am excited to play Everreach: Project Eden when it comes out this fall!"[/i]

[url=https://rectifygaming.com/pax-west-2019-elder-games-everreach-project-eden-rebirths-the-action-sci-fi-genre/][b]Rectify Gaming[/b][/url] summed up that the [i]"[...] majority of viewers accepted the title to plausibly be the game that takes the helm for sci-fi adventure titles from BioWare."[/i]

notes.title: Everreach: Project Eden is an indie action-adventure with a strong Mass Effect vibe
notes.notes:
Everreach: Project Eden is a story-driven, third-person action-RPG set on the distant world of Eden, home of humanity's first interstellar colony. But something's gone wrong (because something always goes wrong), and now it's up to you, as Everreach Security Division Lieutenant Nora Harwood, to explore the world, secure the project, and discover the secrets of the ancient, long-lost civilization that used to call the planet home.

Visually, Everreach is strongly reminiscent of Mass Effect. Nora could easily be a Systems Alliance soldier, and the swooping lines, big windows, and artificial lakes of the planetary settlement brings to mind images of the Citadel. There's a little bit of a Mass Effect connection underlying the story, too, which was written by Michelle Clough, who previously provided narrative-focused Q&A on Mass Effect 3.

I hope that story will play a major role in Everreach: Project Eden, but the primary focus in the announcement is on shooting stuff. Publisher Headup touted it as "packed with tactical ground combat, high-speed vehicular warfare and a compelling level and skill system." There's also a hoverbike you can ride "to engage in high-speed vehicular warfare."

The Steam page leans a little more heavily into the narrative angle, describing Everreach as a "sci-fi epic" with multiple biomes including deserts, forests, and caves, hidden loot, and "optional story elements" revealing the fates of other past civilizations. 

Everreach: Project Eden is currently expected to go live on Steam in September. Find out more at eldgames.com.
